name: Durud Healer

alignment.name: Unaligned
alignment.description:
Unaligned creatures don’t actively seek to harm others or wish them ill. But such creatures also don’t go out of their way to put themselves at risk without some hope for reward. They support law and order when doing so benefits them. They value their own freedom, without worrying too much about protecting the freedom of others.
	A few unaligned people, and most unaligned deities, aren’t undecided about alignment. Rather, they’ve chosen not to choose, either because they see the benefits of both good and evil or because they see themselves as above the concerns of morality. The Raven Queen and her devotees fall into the latter camp, believing that moral choices are irrelevant to their mission, since death comes to all creatures regardless of alignment.

items.name: Chainmail
items.description:
Metal rings woven together into a shirt, leggings, and a hood make up a suit of chainmail. Chainmail grants good protection, but it’s cumbersome, so it reduces your mobility and agility.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Chainmail grants +8 AC at levels 11-15, +9 AC at levels 16-20, +10 AC at levels 21-25, and +12 AC at levels 26-30.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

hit.description: radiant damage, and the target grants combat advantage until the end of the durud healer’s next turn. The first ally of the durud healer to hit the target while it is granting combat advantage in this way regains 20 hit points

effect.description: radiant damage, and the target is immobilized until the end of the durud healer’s next turn;

powers.name: Implacable Determination
powers.trigger: when an enemy within 5 squares of the durud healer scores a critical hit

effect.description: The durud healer can make a basic attack, shift 1 square, or move its speed.

powers.name: Surge Siphon
powers.requirements: when an enemy within 3 squares of the durud healer uses or is the target of a healing power

effect.description: The durud healer shifts 3 squares. If it ends this movement adjacent to the triggering enemy, the healing power grants only half its normal hit points, and each of the durud healer’s allies within 5 squares of it regains 10 hit points.
